title: Even-depth NAND and iterated tribes
statement: For every $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and every assignment $x$ of signs to the quaternary addresses of depth $k$, the depth-$2k$ recursively composed two-input NAND function, given the input at each binary address by reading $x$ at the corresponding quaternary address under the canonical bijection that pairs successive binary digits, equals the depth-$k$ iterated two-by-two tribes function on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a sign to every quaternary address of depth $k$
